# Spec index — `docs/build/specs/`

One paragraph per spec: what surface it covers, the route it lives at in the RR7 port, which build phase(s) consume it (per `docs/build/BUILD-PLAN.md`), and what it depends on. Read `cross-cutting-contracts.md` (same directory) before any phase — it holds the shared shapes/enums every spec assumes.

## domain-model.md
The domain-model source of truth, ported from `design/html-app/app/data.js`: every entity shape (Stage, Task, Packet, TimelineEvent, Run/LogLine, AgentProfile, Policy, Notification, Session, Prefs, Org), every enum value observed, and the complete seed inventory (10 tasks VIB-139..168 with verbatim timelines, 18 runtime runs with full log lines, people, policy, 10 notifications, org defaults). No route — it is cross-cutting. **Primary consumer: Phase 3** (task.md/project.md schemas, projection tables, readiness policy, seed script that must reproduce this data byte-for-byte); Phase 2 consumes the org-user/session shapes, Phase 8 the RUNTIME/LogLine wire formats, Phase 9 the notifications/org/agents seeds. Every other spec references its shapes; when a surface spec and this file disagree on a field, this file wins for data, the surface spec wins for rendering.

## ui-primitives.md
The shared presentational layer from `ui.jsx`: `Icon` (41 verbatim SVG paths), `Pill`/`ReadinessPill`/`ValidationPill` (+ the READINESS/VALIDATION label maps), `AgentGlyph` (claude/codex/op), `Avatar`, `Identity`, `PageOverlay`, `TglP`, `useToasts`/`ToastHost`, `initialsOf`, and the `initPrefs` theme/motion machinery. Lives at `app/ui/*` (must not import from `features/`), no route. **Consumed by Phase 1** (viberr.css port + theme/FOUC handling in `root.tsx`) and **built in Phase 4** alongside the shell; literally every later surface imports from it. Contains the canonical readiness-enum→pill-CSS mapping table (§3.3) that resolves the `input` vs `input_required` naming split — depends only on domain-model for identity shapes.

## login.md
The sign-in screen (`login.jsx`): OAuth provider buttons (whitelist-based, stubbed without env creds), local email/password form, and the forced password-reset step (admin-set `pwreset` flag). Route: `/login` (+ `POST /logout`, `/auth/github|google` + callbacks). **Phase 2.** Depends on: domain-model (session/org-user shapes), org-settings (whitelist model, `pwreset` flag is set there), ui-primitives (`Icon`, field CSS). Seeds `arda@viberr.dev` / `2828` so on-screen hints stay true. The forced-reset step must be server-authoritative (partial session), not client state.

## shell.md
The workspace shell (`main.jsx`): left rail with live counts, topbar (brand, crumbs, decorative ⌘K search, bell popover, user menu), view routing across the seven project views + task detail, toasts, theme cycling, Profile/Notifications overlays, and **all cross-view mutation handlers** (task create, packet resolve, ownership, comment, scope grant, notification reads — the exact event copy each writes). Route: layout for `/projects/:slug` with children `board|review|agents|policy|github|activity|settings` and `tasks/:key`. **Phase 4.** Depends on: ui-primitives, domain-model, board/task-detail (children it mounts), notifications (bell popover markup duplicated here — port once). Its §5 mutation contract is the behavioral spec Phases 5/7/9 implement server-side.

## home.md
The multi-project landing page (`home.jsx`): greeting hero with org-wide agent stats, pinned/all project directory (grid/list, ⌘K search), New-governed-project modal (name/key/connection/repo/template/policy preset), org Settings tiles deep-linking to `/org/settings`, store-strip Re-scan, plus its own header bell/user-menu and Profile/Notifications overlays. Route: `/`. **Phase 4.** Depends on: ui-primitives, domain-model (stages for StageMeter, notifications), org-settings (connection list feeds the create modal; tiles summarize org data), notifications/profile (overlay content). Project-create is the only file-writing mutation (Phase 3 store + Phase 9 org data must exist for the modal's connection picker to be real).

## board.md
The project board (`board.jsx`): stage columns (no DnD — transitions are governed actions elsewhere), agent-aware task cards (readiness pill, owner/specialist line, branch/PR trace chips, wait tags, urgent), 4-chip filter bar, flat list mode, New-task modal, manual Re-scan. Route: `/projects/:slug/board` (default redirect of `/projects/:slug`). **Phase 4.** Depends on: shell (mounts it; create-task action lives at app root in mock), ui-primitives (ReadinessPill/AgentGlyph/Avatar), domain-model (task/stage shapes), Phase 3 (projection loader + rescan action). Card click → task-detail route.

## task-detail.md
The operator-first task workspace (`task.jsx`): hero (stage/readiness/validation pills + canonical file path), decision-packet card with radiogroup options and resolve/ask actions, execution profile (operator/specialist/consultants/owner + OwnerControl menu), release-confirm alertdialog, unified timeline (9 event types, RichText, composer with @agent routing, filters), GitHub trace sidebar, current-state and permissions panels. Route: `/projects/:slug/tasks/:key`. **Phase 5.** Depends on: shell (mutation handlers + `myRole`), runs.md (LiveRunPanel/AgentLogsPanel mount inside it — Phase 8 wiring), domain-model (packet/event shapes and exact decision-event copy), ui-primitives, Phase 3 (event-log writer), Phase 7 (accept-completion → PR merge). Its §5 resolve/ownership/comment tables are the canonical action contract.

## tweaks-panel.md
The prototyping harness's floating dev "Tweaks" overlay (`tweaks-panel.jsx`) — **explicitly NOT a product surface; the spec's verdict is DO NOT PORT** (dead code: no HTML entry loads it, no component uses it; it is omelette-host tooling with its own `twk-*` CSS namespace). No route, **no phase**. Only obligations: record the exclusion in the phase-4 report and drop the stale "+ tweaks-panel.jsx" load-order comment when porting `home.jsx`. Note: BUILD-PLAN Phase 5 says "Port task.jsx + tweaks-panel.jsx" — this spec overrides that line (see cross-cutting-contracts §7, inconsistency #14).

## review-queue.md
The human acceptance boundary (`review.jsx`): read-only two-panel triage list of review-stage tasks split by `waiting` ("Waiting on your acceptance" vs "Still with agents"), rows navigating to task detail, and a policy chip explaining the human-locked Review→Done boundary. Route: `/projects/:slug/review`. **Phase 9** (BUILD-PLAN lists `review.jsx` there; the packet-resolution flow it depends on ships in Phase 5). Depends on: task-detail (acceptance actually happens there), shell (rail badge = all review-stage tasks), ui-primitives (ValidationPill), Phase 6 SSE (rows must leave live on acceptance). Zero mutations on this surface.

## runs.md
The agent-runtime panels inside task detail (`runs.jsx`): `LiveRunPanel` (live run strip with phase/step, elapsed/turns/tokens tickers, Interrupt, concurrent-run picker) and `AgentLogsPanel` (dark console, thread dropdown, raw-JSON toggle, auto-follow, four run-state footers), plus the `rawLine` reconstruction that doubles as the NDJSON/JSONL wire-format contract for the Claude and Codex adapters. No own route — rendered inside `/projects/:slug/tasks/:key`. **Phase 8** (adapters, run registry, SSE `run.log-appended`, simulated backend); the panel shells mount in Phase 5. Depends on: domain-model (RUNTIME/LogLine shapes + all 18 seed runs), task-detail (parent-held `logSel` wiring), Phase 6 SSE, ui-primitives.

## agents.md
The project agent-governance surface (`agents.jsx`): profile roster (operator + specialists) with eligible stages, three-bucket capability policy, context resources and backend/model, live-deployment derivation from tasks, Live tab roster table, create/edit/delete-profile modals, and the shared `CapabilityMatrixModal` (also used by Policy). Route: `/projects/:slug/agents`. **Phase 9** (runtime states inform it via Phase 8). Depends on: domain-model (AGENTS seed + CAP/RES catalogs), policy.md (shares the matrix modal + capability color language), org-settings (global agent templates vs project profiles — the two-layer model is an open architecture question), shell, ui-primitives. Its `deployments()` derivation must become a projection query; the role-string join must become a profile-id FK.

## policy.md
The project governance surface (`policy.jsx`): Human access (member role picker with last-admin guard + read-only 9-row RBAC grant table), Agent capability summary (per-profile direct/recommend/human counts + hard-coded "Always reserved for humans" list), Workflow rules (stage flow + per-transition boundary segments, `review→done` locked to Human only), and the shared capability-matrix modal. Route: `/projects/:slug/policy`. **Phase 9.** Depends on: agents.md (CapabilityMatrixModal + profiles), domain-model (POLICY.members/rbac/transitions), project-settings (membership CRUD lives there; roles here — cross-linked both ways), Phase 3 (`.viberr/policy/` file-native boundaries). Carries the canonical RBAC table every action guard in Phases 5–10 must enforce.

## github-view.md
The GitHub traceability dashboard (`github.jsx`): repository panel (connection, masked PAT, scope chips, scope-violation banner with "Fix in Settings"), pull-request list, execution-branch table with derived sync pills, and the Reconcile action. Route: `/projects/:slug/github`. **Phase 7** (BUILD-PLAN puts the `github.jsx` port + PAT store/validator + real GitHub client there). Depends on: project-settings (the Grant-scope resolution lives there; shared `cred-card` — build one `CredentialCard` component), task-detail (rows link to tasks; violation is a typed `policy` event on VIB-142), shell (`scopeGranted` → must become server-derived scope-check state feeding 4 surfaces), Phase 6 SSE, review-queue row/`live-table` CSS families (reuse, don't fork).

## activity.md
The project-wide activity feed (`activity.jsx`): a flattened cross-task timeline stream (day-grouped, actor-kind filter All/Humans/Agents/System) and the Audit-logs panel (violation/blockedact/change/audit rows with open/resolved pills). Route: `/projects/:slug/activity`. **Phase 9**, with **Phase 10** extending the audit side (real audit table, per-violation resolution). Read-only. Depends on: every event-writing surface (task-detail, shell, settings — its §5 table lists the producers), domain-model (POLICY.events shapes), `RichA` shared renderer (also used by notifications), github-view/settings (`scopeGranted` → per-violation state).

## project-settings.md
The per-project admin surface (`settings.jsx`): project identity (name/prefix/description), workflow-stages editor (rename/HTML5-DnD reorder/add/remove with triage/done locks), members panel (invite/remove with self and last-admin guards), repository & credentials (override toggle, cred-card with **Grant scope** — the resolution of the VIB-142 violation), danger zone. Route: `/projects/:slug/settings`. **Phase 9** for the surface; the credential card/grant-scope flow is **Phase 7**. Depends on: policy.md (role management split: Settings = membership CRUD, Policy = roles; cross-links), github-view (shared cred-card + violation state), board (stage edits drive columns live), Phase 3 (project-file writer for stages/identity), domain-model.

## org-settings.md
The instance-level admin surface (`org-settings.jsx`, tabbed): GitHub connections (PAT add/replace/set-default/remove with scope-validation gating), Users & access (whitelist users/domains, admin/member role toggles, edit user, local password reset), and Agent resources (knowledge bases, MCP servers, skills, global agent profiles — four CRUD panels + the StoreBrowser popup). Also fully specifies `MiniModal`/`ConfirmDelete` dialog chrome. Route: `/org/settings` (tab in URL, default `connections`). **Phase 9**; the users/whitelist/pwreset model is consumed by **Phase 2** (auth) and connections by **Phase 7** (PAT store). Depends on: kb-browser.md (StoreBrowser), home.md (entry tiles + header chrome question), login.md (pwreset/setup-link flow), domain-model (ORG_DEFAULTS). Needs home.css classes available on the route.

## notifications.md
The user-global notifications surface in both forms: the full page (`notifications.jsx` — "Waiting on you" packet/approval cards + "Everything else" day-grouped stream, All/Unread filter, mark-all-read) and the bell popover (duplicated in both shells — port once). Route: `/notifications` (+ bell in every authenticated layout). **Phase 9** (bell popover markup ships with the Phase 4 shell; per-user read rows in SQLite). Depends on: domain-model (NOTIFICATIONS fixture + kinds), shell/home (popover mounts + cross-project dead-end toast that must become real navigation), task-detail (packet resolution auto-marks related notifications read), profile (routing prefs that the real fan-out must honor), activity (`RichA`), Phase 6 SSE (live badge).

## profile.md
The personal account overlay (`profile.jsx`): identity (name/title/read-only email + membership facts), notification routing toggles, "Your access" read-only RBAC view, GitHub identity connect/disconnect (attribution only), and the built-but-unmounted Appearance panel (theme/motion/timeline-default). Route: `/profile` (overlay-style, deep-linkable). **Phase 9** (theme/prefs plumbing starts in Phase 1/4; password change is Phase 2 machinery). Depends on: ui-primitives (PageOverlay, TglP, prefs schema), policy.md (RBAC matrix + role pill — mock hardcodes `maintainer`), notifications (pref kind ids), login/org-settings (password reset flow), shell/home (two divergent `me` states collapse into the session user).

## kb-browser.md
The generic store-folder file manager (`kb-browser.jsx` → `StoreBrowser`): modal tree view over `store://kb/<dir>/` or `store://skills/<name>/` with file/folder upload (structure-preserving), drag & drop, nested folder creation, GitHub snapshot import (fake in mock), delete-with-confirm, and SKILL.md text capture. No own route — opened from `/org/settings` Agent resources. **Phase 9.** Depends on: org-settings (only consumer; owns the data and toasts), Phase 3 (file-native store is canonical — every operation must be a real fs mutation + re-scan), Phase 7 (real GitHub import needs a connection), ui-primitives (Icon, modal chrome). Exports `countKbFiles`/`prettySize`/`FolderIco` used by org-settings rows.

---

### Phase → spec quick map

| Phase | Specs consumed |
|---|---|
| 1 Scaffold | ui-primitives (CSS/theme/FOUC), login (theme on `/login`) |
| 2 Auth & org | login, org-settings (users/whitelist/pwreset), domain-model (session/org shapes) |
| 3 File store & projections | **domain-model** (schemas + seed), board/task-detail (file paths, frontmatter fields), policy (`.viberr/policy/`) |
| 4 Shell, Home, Board | shell, home, board, ui-primitives, notifications (bell popover) |
| 5 Task detail | task-detail, domain-model (packet/event copy), runs (panel mounts), ~~tweaks-panel~~ (excluded) |
| 6 SSE | requirements embedded in board, task-detail, review-queue, runs, github-view, notifications |
| 7 GitHub | github-view, project-settings (cred-card/grant-scope), org-settings (connections), login (OAuth) |
| 8 Runtimes | runs, domain-model (RUNTIME + wire formats), agents (runtime states) |
| 9 Remaining surfaces | review-queue, agents, policy, project-settings, org-settings, activity, notifications, profile, kb-browser |
| 10 Audit & recovery | activity (audit panel), github-view/settings (violation lifecycle), runs (audit-logged session opens) |
| 11 Hardening | all (golden path: login → board → task → resolve packet → done) |
